orchestrator.description: Plans Power BI analytics work, delegates to specialist agents, and gates destructive or external actions behind user confirmation.

data_analyst.description: Loads, profiles and quality-checks datasets; proposes KPIs, dimensions and insights using deterministic tools.

data_engineer.description: Cleans and reshapes data into analytical datasets; never overwrites source data.

powerbi_modeler.description: Designs star-schema semantic models and produces PBIP/TMDL or MCP changes after inspecting the existing model.

dax_expert.description: Writes, reuses and validates DAX measures.

report_designer.description: Produces a report specification (pages, visuals, slicers, layout) against a validated semantic model.

validator.description: Validates data, model, DAX and report artifacts and returns structured findings.
